description: Foam play-food pieces are spread out on the bed, including slices of bread, a fried egg, cucumber rounds, a lettuce leaf, and a yellow cheese slice, with a bright green plate in front. The right hand repeatedly reaches in from the right to place a bread slice on the plate and stack toppings on it—first a brown speckled patty, then the white-and-red spread pieces, then the fried egg—while the left hand picks up the cucumber cluster and lays it on top; the left hand then adds the lettuce and cheese, and finally slides toward the remaining bread slice as the right hand hovers near the plate.
